policyEndpoint.title: Policy bundle URL
policyEndpoint.description: Full URL of the policy endpoint (GET /api/v1/policies). Point this at a self-hosted / on-premises server to keep all control-plane traffic inside your network.

telemetryUrl.title: Telemetry URL
telemetryUrl.description: Full URL of POST /api/v1/telemetry/prompt-events. Only SHA-256 prompt hashes and category counts are sent — never prompt text.

apiKey.title: Telemetry API key
apiKey.description: Organisation API key sent as X-API-Key / Bearer to the endpoints above.

telemetryDisabled.title: Disable all telemetry
telemetryDisabled.description: When true, no detection events leave the device, regardless of any other setting. All detection still runs locally.

enforcementMode.title: Enforcement mode
enforcementMode.description: guideline = coach the user and let them decide (recommended to start); strict = redact automatically and block flagged uploads.

appealUrl.title: Exception request URL
appealUrl.description: Link shown to users when something is blocked, e.g. your service-desk form.

injectionDetection.title: Prompt-injection and hidden-text detection
injectionDetection.description: Flag instruction-override phrasing and invisible Unicode in prompts and uploaded text files. Default true.

customRules.title: Confidential-term rules
customRules.description: Organisation-specific terms or patterns to treat as confidential (project code names, client names, document-ID formats).

fileGuard.title: Upload guard
fileGuard.description: Checks files uploaded to AI sites: confidential file names, and high-severity content in text files.
